name: Síle na gCíoch
text: Síle na gCíoch is an Irish rendering of the Sheela na Gig name. The dictionary prints the forms Site na gCioch and Sile-na-Gig. It stands beside the parallel form Síghle na gCíoch. The full record sits under the Sheela na Gig node.
